class.name: AudioMixSnapshotController
class.brief_description: Deterministic source-keyed audio bus mix stages with independent fade-in and fade-out.
class.description: Inspired by Unreal Engine Control Bus Mixes. Each named mix profile provides up to eight bus attenuation values in decibels, from -30 through 0. Up to 16 named mix profiles may be active or fading simultaneously. Profiles can overlap on a bus; their faded dB offsets are added, limited to -60 dB per bus. [method tick] advances fade weights independent of the frame rate. Mixes are data-only and do not modify [AudioServer] directly, enabling the caller to combine their output with user volume controls and transient event ducking. Validation is atomic; invalid operations leave all existing mix profiles untouched.

method.name: activate_mix
method.description: Creates or reactivates a named mix. Keys must be valid nonempty bus names; values must be numeric, finite attenuation in [-30, 0]. A fade in the range [0, 15] seconds is accepted. Re-activation of a fading mix resumes from its current weight.

method.name: deactivate_mix
method.description: Fades the named mix out; with a zero fade it is removed immediately. Does not affect other mixes.

method.name: tick
method.description: Advances independent mix fades without invoking AudioServer. Invalid or nonpositive deltas are ignored.

method.name: get_bus_offset_db
method.description: Returns the sum of active, faded dB offsets on the named bus, clamped to [-60, 0]. Does not include the user slider or transient ducking.

method.name: get_mix_weight
method.description: Returns the current fade weight (0 to 1) of a named mix, or 0 when absent.

method.name: has_mix
method.description: Returns true while the mix exists, including during fade-out.

method.name: get_mix_count
method.description: Returns the number of active and fading mix profiles (at most 16).
